name: band-of-burning-verdict-rest-buff-requires-activation
notes:
Positive-fix fixture for Band of Burning Verdict's (7mmve2l328, REGALIA/ITEM/TAMER accessory) second defect. cardActivatedAbilities['7mmve2l328:0'] used to be dispatched unconditionally by OnCardActivated() (GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GameLogic.php) immediately after the card materialized -- an unprompted MZCHOOSE for the printed '[Class Bonus] [REST]: Target Animal or Beast ally you control gets +1 POWER and gains true sight until end of turn' buff appeared right after Enter, with no REST cost ever paid, before any explicit player activation. Same Tamer-champion + Cheerful Slime (Animal ally) setup as band-of-burning-verdict-enter-draw so the ability is legally activatable. Sequence: (1) play Band of Burning Verdict from hand (mode=10002 FSM) -- On Enter draws a card (deck 3 -> 2); step-1 assertions confirm the Cheerful Slime (myField-1) is untouched (TurnEffects == ["ENTERED_THIS_TURN"], computed POWER == 1) -- the buff has NOT auto-fired. (2) Explicitly activate Band of Burning Verdict's own ability index 0 via the direct myField!CustomInput!Activate:0 click (mode=10001, myField-2!CustomInput!Activate:0 -- the same no-opportunity-needed mechanism the charm-of-anticipation-banish-draw fixture uses for vkL2RFh0yM's activateAbilityAbilities entry, also a REGALIA/ITEM card). (3) Answer the resulting MZCHOOSE with the Cheerful Slime (myField-1). Final-state assertions confirm the buff is now applied only after this explicit activation: TurnEffects == ["ENTERED_THIS_TURN","7mmve2l328","TRUE_SIGHT"] and computed POWER == 2 (1 base + 1 buff).

Fixed by neutralizing the wrong cardActivatedAbilities['7mmve2l328:0'] entry to a no-op in GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php (correcting an existing-but-wrong generated entry, matching that file's established 'Destroy target X' override convention) and registering the buff's real condition (the relocated IsClassBonusActive(['TAMER']) + Animal/Beast-ally-exists checks) and body as a proper activateAbilityAbilities['7mmve2l328:0']/activateAbilityPrereqs['7mmve2l328:0'] pair in GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GameLogic.php -- a missing addition, matching the Charm of Anticipation precedent (vkL2RFh0yM, also REGALIA/ITEM), including the same $staticAbilityCount patch inside DoActivatedAbility() (CardActivateAbilityCount('7mmve2l328') reads 0 from the wholesale-reassigned generated array, which can't be safely added to from hand-editable code). Also generalized GrandArchiveSim/Custom/CustomInput.php's existing 'route field ability clicks with no matching activateAbilityAbilities entry through ActivateCard instead' fallback to first check whether a real activateAbilityAbilities entry exists for the clicked card+index, so a genuinely-registered field ability (like this one) is never misrouted into ActivateCard just because the card also happens to carry an unrelated, generated-nonzero CardCardActivatedCount.

Break/restore verified: with GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GameLogic.php, GrandArchiveSim/Custom/CustomInput.php and GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php reverted to their pre-fix (HEAD) content, step 1's zone_count(myDeck)==2 assertion already fails (reports 'got 3') -- under the old bug the auto-fired MZCHOOSE for the buff target is queued synchronously inside OnCardActivated(), before the card's own On Enter draw (which resolves via a separately-queued effect-stack trigger) gets a chance to run in the same action, so the single FSM play action leaves the draw unresolved and the illegitimate MZCHOOSE pending instead. Restoring the three files makes all assertions (including the step-3 post-activation buff checks) pass again.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] [REST]: Target Animal or Beast ally you control gets +1 POWER and gains true sight until end of turn.
